documentation.direction: Every rule is one-sided. Only movement away from parity or away from Flow's runtime advantage fails the gate.
documentation.runtime_log2_ratio: log2(sklearn_ms / flow_ms). Higher is better for Flow. A row fails when the value drops by more than the applicable threshold, never when it rises.
documentation.thresholds: Each threshold sits above the measured run-to-run spread of the metric it guards. See benchmarks/test_disparity_regression_policy.py for the fixtures that pin the behaviour.
